correctness.rationale: The gauge-fixed Fubini integral yields z~Beta(p-1,q+1), with exact conditional independent uniform coordinates. Beta moments, permutation contrasts and the normalized between-block vector give the stated three eigenvalues and full multiplicities. The differences λB−λP=p(q−p−3)/(3n(n+1)) and λQ−λB=q(q−p+3)/(3n(n+1)) prove the strict integer transition. The p=2 boundary is included. Exact-rational independent simplex integration corroborates the zero centroid and all 174 covariance entries in six cases, and confirms normalization. The general proof is analytic, not extrapolated from finite examples.

value.rationale: The uniform-volume covariance is an intrinsic, naturally motivated geometric invariant of a continuous family of polars of graph-root polytopes. Its complete spectral classification exposes a sharp q=p+3 switch of the least-variance invariant subspace, exact multiplicities and a closed anisotropy condition number. The balanced near-isotropy and unbalanced quadratic growth give structural asymptotics not inferred from scalar volume or Ehrhart data; this is not an arbitrary finite statistic.
